dash.title: Dashboard
dash.service_down_body: The background service that does the actual routing is not running. Proxity needs it installed and running to route traffic.
dash.install_service_hint: Windows will ask for administrator (UAC) consent.
dash.service_binary_missing: proxity-service.exe was not found — reinstall the app or place the service binary next to Proxity.
dash.stop_engine_body: If the engine stops, apps routed through a proxy may lose internet access. Continue?

wizard.title: Proxity Setup
wizard.welcome_body: Proxity routes the internet traffic of apps you choose through a proxy. You'll be ready in 3 short steps: add a proxy, pick an app, done.
wizard.proxy_help: Enter the SOCKS5 address and port from your provider.
wizard.app_step_title: 2. Which app should use the proxy?
wizard.app_help: Pick a running app or point at an .exe file.
wizard.drop_hint: You can also drag and drop an .exe onto this window.
wizard.done_body: Setup is complete. Start the engine from the Dashboard and add more apps or proxies anytime.
wizard.skip_confirm_body: You will continue without adding a proxy or an app. You can add them later.
wizard.no_proxies_yet: You need to add a proxy first.

proxies.title: Proxies
proxies.empty_body: Start by adding a SOCKS5 proxy. Your apps can then reach the internet through it.
proxies.delete_body: "{name}" will be deleted. App rules using it will stop working until they pick another proxy.
proxies.password_keep: Enter a new password to change it; leave empty to keep the current one.

rules.title: Applications
rules.empty_body: Pick an app and assign a proxy, direct or block rule. You can also drag and drop an .exe onto this window.
rules.delete_body: The rule "{name}" will be deleted. This app will fall back to the default behavior.
rules.kill_switch_hint: If the proxy drops, this app's internet is cut too (no IP leaks).
rules.new_conn_note: Rules apply only to new connections; open connections are unaffected.
rules.proc_no_path: Path unavailable (may be a system process)
rules.conflict_body: A rule already targets this path: {name}. Save anyway?
rules.path_required: Pick an app or a folder
rules.proxy_required: Pick a proxy for the proxy action
rules.priority_hint: Higher priority wins when folder rules overlap.
rules.folder_rule_hint: Applies to apps inside this folder.

conns.title: Connections
conns.empty: Nothing to show right now. Connections appear here while the engine is running and apps go online.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.reset_body: All recorded usage statistics will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
stats.empty: No recorded data in this range.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.empty: No blocked connections. Entries appear here when the kill switch steps in.
blocked.clear_body: The blocked-connection log will be deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart_service_hint: Installs the service to auto-start with Windows; requires administrator consent.
settings.uninstall_body: The Proxity background service will be removed; proxy routing and the kill switch stop completely. Settings and rules are kept.
settings.autostart_gui: Start the Proxity window with Windows
settings.kill_switch_hint: If the engine stops, all internet traffic is cut.
settings.kill_switch_body: When enabled, ALL internet access is cut if the engine stops — including apps not using a proxy. Are you sure?
settings.lan_hint: Printers, NAS and other LAN devices stay reachable even with the kill switch on.
settings.notif_blocked: Notify when a connection is blocked
settings.default_action: Default action for apps without a rule
settings.defaults_body: All settings will return to factory values. Proxies and rules are not deleted.
settings.import_overwrite: Overwrite existing proxies with the same id
settings.pick_import: Choose a JSON file to import
settings.quit_body: The app closes completely. This does not stop the engine — only the interface closes.
settings.minimize_hint: Closing the window minimizes to the tray; use Quit in the tray menu to exit fully.

service.uac_cancelled: Install was cancelled because administrator consent was not given.
service.autostart_reg_fail: Could not change the startup entry
